learning_outcomes.text: Ability to select, design, deploy, integrate and manage communication networks and infrastructures in an organization
Know the architectures of corporate networks and the technologies for their interconnection to the Internet
Design corporate networks taking into account economic, security and quality of service issues
Know the services and protocols that allow configuring and managing corporate networks

syllabus_topics: T5 – Wireless WLAN and WiMax networks
T6 – Cable and fiber optic networks
T7 – Corporate network planning case study
T8 – Public defense of group work
P1 – IOS operating system. Ethernet networks
P6 – Configuration of access lists in corporate networks
P8 – Implementation of a corporate network
P9 – LAN network modeling and simulation
P10 – Design and traffic analysis in a corporate network
P11 – Integration and interconnection of wired and wireless networks within an organization
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, to pass the subject, each part must be satisfactorily completed. The final grade is calculated as 0.25 x Group Work + 0.10 x Individual Work + 0.40 x Laboratory Practices + 0.25 x Final Test. Group and individual assignments can only be done in the ordinary call, and attendance to oral defense sessions for group work is mandatory. For the extraordinary call, approved group and individual work from the ordinary call are considered; otherwise, the grade is 0 for those parts, with a specific formula for 'Work Grade'. If laboratory practices were not passed in the ordinary call, a practical exam must be passed with at least 5/10. A final knowledge test must also be passed with at least 5/10. The final grade for the extraordinary call is 0.25 x Final Test + 0.4 x Laboratory Practices + 0.35 x Work Grade. For differentiated evaluation, a face-to-face exam covering theoretical and practical content will be held, with the final grade calculated as 0.7 x Theoretical Face-to-face Test + 0.3 x Practical Face-to-face Test.
